mapper.sql: SELECT b.BILL_ID AS "billId",b.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",b.BILL_ORD AS "billOrder", b.BILL_YM AS "billMonth",b.BILL_DT AS "billDate",b.SPLY_AMT AS "supplyAmount", b.VAT_RT AS "vatRate",b.VAT_AMT AS "vatAmount",b.TOT_AMT AS "totalAmount", b.RCPT_SUM_AMT AS "receiptSumAmount",b.UNPAID_AMT AS "unpaidAmount", b.PAY_DUE_DT AS "payDueDate",b.TAX_INVC_NO AS "taxInvoiceNo",(b.CNCL_YN='Y') AS "cancelled", b.CNCL_RSN AS "cancelReason",b.CNCL_USER_ID AS "cancelledBy",b.CNCL_DTTM AS "cancelledAt", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",COALESCE(c.CLNT_NM,'') AS "customerName", p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "projectType",p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "projectStatus", p.CTRT_BGN_DT AS "projectStart",p.CTRT_END_DT AS "projectEnd", (b.CNCL_YN='N' AND b.BILL_ID=(SELECT x.BILL_ID FROM TB_BL_BILL x WHERE x.PROJ_ID=b.PROJ_ID AND x.CNCL_YN='N' ORDER BY x.BILL_YM DESC,x.BILL_ID DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "latest", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE cl WHERE cl.CLOSE_YM=b.BILL_YM AND cl.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE') AS "closed", (SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM TB_BL_RCPT r WHERE r.BILL_ID=b.BILL_ID AND r.CNCL_YN='N') AS "normalReceiptCount", COALESCE(b.MOD_DTTM,b.REG_DTTM) AS "modifiedAt" FROM TB_BL_BILL b JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=b.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=p.CUST_CLNT_ID
mapper.select: WHERE b.BILL_YM BETWEEN CAST(CAST(#{year} AS text)||'01' AS CHAR(6)) AND CAST(CAST(#{year} AS text)||'12' AS CHAR(6)) ORDER BY b.BILL_DT DESC,b.BILL_ID
WHERE b.BILL_ID=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF b

SELECT r.RCPT_ID::text AS "receiptId",r.RCPT_DT AS "receiptDate",r.RCPT_AMT AS "amount", (r.CNCL_YN='Y') AS "cancelled",r.CNCL_RSN AS "cancelReason",r.CNCL_USER_ID AS "cancelledBy", r.CNCL_DTTM AS "cancelledAt",(r.CNCL_YN='N' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_YM=to_char(r.RCPT_DT,'YYYYMM') AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE')) AS "canCancel", COALESCE(r.MOD_DTTM,r.REG_DTTM) AS "modifiedAt" FROM TB_BL_RCPT r WHERE r.BILL_ID=#{id} ORDER BY r.RCPT_DT,r.RCPT_ID
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.RCPT_AMT),0) FROM TB_BL_RCPT r WHERE r.BILL_ID=#{id} AND r.CNCL_YN='N'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_YM=#{month} AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_BL_BILL b WHERE b.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND b.BILL_YM=#{month} AND b.CNCL_YN='N')
WHERE b.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND b.BILL_YM=#{month} AND b.CNCL_YN='N' ORDER BY b.BILL_ID
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE TB_PJ_ASGN_MON IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode",a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputTypeCode", m.MON_MM AS "monthlyMm",COALESCE(m.APLY_UPRC,0) AS "billingPrice" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=m.PROJ_ID WHERE m.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND m.INPUT_YM=#{month} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' AND a.INPUT_TYPE_CD<>'FREE' AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD IN ('MO','DP') ORDER BY m.ASGN_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BL_BILL SET BILL_DT=#{values.billDate},SPLY_AMT=#{amounts.supplyAmount}, VAT_RT=#{amounts.vatRate},VAT_AMT=#{amounts.vatAmount},TOT_AMT=#{amounts.totalAmount}, RCPT_SUM_AMT=#{receipts},UNPAID_AMT=#{amounts.totalAmount}-#{receipts}, PAY_DUE_DT=#{values.payDueDate},TAX_INVC_NO=#{values.taxInvoiceNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MOD_USER_ID=#{actor},MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp() WHERE BILL_ID=#{billId} AND CNCL_YN='N' AND COALESCE(MOD_DTTM,REG_DTTM) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}

UPDATE TB_BL_BILL SET CNCL_YN='Y',CNCL_RSN=#{reason},CNCL_USER_ID=#{actor}, CNCL_DTTM=clock_timestamp(),MOD_USER_ID=#{actor},MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp() WHERE BILL_ID=#{billId} AND CNCL_YN='N' AND COALESCE(MOD_DTTM,REG_DTTM) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
mapper.select:
WITH project_part AS ( SELECT h.PART_ID FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART h WHERE h.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND h.APLY_BGN_YM<=#{month} ORDER BY h.APLY_BGN_YM DESC LIMIT 1 ), leaders AS ( SELECT s.PART_LDR_USER_ID AS user_id FROM TB_BS_PART_STD s JOIN TB_SY_USER leader ON leader.USER_ID=s.PART_LDR_USER_ID AND leader.USER_STAT_CD='USE' JOIN project_part pp ON pp.PART_ID=s.PART_ID JOIN TB_BS_PART p ON p.PART_ID=pp.PART_ID AND p.HQ_YN='N' WHERE s.APLY_BGN_YM<=#{month} AND (s.APLY_END_YM IS NULL OR s.APLY_END_YM>=#{month}) UNION SELECT sc.USER_ID FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE sc JOIN project_part pp ON pp.PART_ID=sc.PART_ID JOIN TB_SY_USER leader ON leader.USER_ID=sc.USER_ID AND leader.USER_STAT_CD='USE' JOIN TB_BS_PART p ON p.PART_ID=pp.PART_ID AND p.HQ_YN='Y' JOIN TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur ON ur.USER_ID=sc.USER_ID AND ur.ROLE_ID='SALES_LDR' ) SELECT DISTINCT u.USER_ID AS "userId",u.USER_NM AS "name",u.EMAIL_ADDR AS "email" FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.USER_STAT_CD='USE' AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_USER_SCOPE sc ON sc.USER_ID=ur.USER_ID WHERE ur.USER_ID=u.USER_ID AND ur.ROLE_ID='PM' AND sc.PROJ_ID=#{projectId})
OR u.USER_ID IN (SELECT l.user_id FROM leaders l) OR (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM leaders) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur WHERE ur.USER_ID=u.USER_ID AND ur.ROLE_ID='EXEC'))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur WHERE ur.USER_ID=u.USER_ID AND ur.ROLE_ID IN ('EXEC','FIN'))
) ORDER BY u.USER_ID
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_BL_DUN_HIST h WHERE h.BILL_ID=#{id} AND h.DUN_STEP=#{step} AND h.RESEND_YN='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_BL_DUN_HIST h WHERE h.BILL_ID=#{id} AND h.DUN_STEP=#{step} AND h.RESEND_YN='N')
SELECT BILL_ID FROM TB_BL_BILL WHERE CNCL_YN='N' AND UNPAID_AMT>0 ORDER BY BILL_ID
SELECT count(*) FROM TB_BL_BILL WHERE CNCL_YN='N' AND UNPAID_AMT>0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BL_DUN_HIST(BILL_ID,DUN_SN,DUN_STEP,SEND_DT,RCVR_DESC,SEND_MTHD_CD,RESEND_YN,REG_USER_ID,REG_DTTM) SELECT #{billId},COALESCE(MAX(h.DUN_SN),0)+1,#{step},#{date},#{recipients},'BOTH', CASE WHEN #{resend} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{actor},clock_timestamp() FROM TB_BL_DUN_HIST h WHERE h.BILL_ID=#{billId}
